judge.refused_contestant: The judge can't be one of the models being compared.
judge.refused_same_maker: The judge has to come from a maker that made neither model being compared. {model} is by {maker}, like {like}.
judge.unknown: No model called {name} on your providers. Judges you can pick: {slugs}
judge.maker_unknown: The judge has to come from a maker that made neither model being compared.
judge.pick_unreachable: {judge} can't be reached. Judged blind by {auto} (auto) instead.
judge.list.hidden_note: {maker} models aren't listed. The judge has to come from a maker that made neither model being compared.
start.judge_line: Judged blind by {judge} (auto). It compares each pair without knowing which model wrote which.
start.judge_user: Judged blind by {judge}, your pick. It compares each pair without knowing which model wrote which.
start.judge_backup: Backup judging: both models judge each pair blind. None of your providers has a judge from a third maker, so only results they agree on count.
fine.backup: Backup judging: both models judged each pair blind. None of your providers had a judge from a third maker. A turn counts as won or lost only when both agreed; {disagreements} of the {same} "same" are turns where they disagreed.
cli.judge_help: --judge <model>   Pick the judge. It must come from a maker that made neither model. Default: Shadow picks one.
receipt.caption: {trying} vs your {current}, per turn
receipt.so_far: · so far, too few to read
verdict.reason.better: {trying} did better than your {current} on your turns.
verdict.reason.holds_up: {trying} kept up with your {current} on your turns.
verdict.reason.holds_neither: {trying} kept up with your {current} on your turns, but it isn't cheaper or faster.
verdict.reason.worse: {trying} did worse than your {current} on your turns.
verdict.reason.too_close: These turns couldn't separate {trying} from your {current}.
verdict.reason.cap: Stopped at your ${cap:.2f} cap after {pairs} usable turns. Shadow needs 20.
verdict.reason.rate_limited: {provider} turned requests down twice, so the test stopped after {pairs} usable turns. Shadow needs 20.
verdict.reason.few_usable: Only {pairs} of {picked} turns could be used; on {unusable} both models failed or the judge's answer was unusable. Shadow needs 20.
verdict.reason.judge_unsure: {judge} picked the same way both orders on only {agree} of {pairs} turns. Shadow needs 7 in 10 before it trusts the judge.
verdict.reason.runs_varied: Your {current} differed from itself on {varied} of 10 reruns, too much for 30 turns to separate two models.
sure.luck: If the two were really even, luck would give a gap this big {luck}.
sure.worst: Worst case this test leaves open: it loses {count} more turns than it wins, per 100.
sure.even: Worst case this test leaves open: about even with yours.
sure.lean_better: It leans better, but a gap this small is easily luck.
sure.lean_worse: It leans worse, but a gap this small is easily luck.
sure.few: Too few turns to read a result from.
fine.scale: For scale: your model, run twice on {reruns} of these turns, differed from itself on {varied}.
fine.web_on: Web lookups ran for real on {count} of these turns, with the same pages for both models.
fine.web_off: Web lookups were off, so {count} turns that needed one stopped there, the same way for both models.
fine.second: Second look, {pairs} turns. The bar is higher on a second look, so an answer needs a bigger gap than before.
maths.method: Interval: wins minus losses over matched pairs, with 0.5 added to each cell (Agresti and Min, 2005). Sign test: exact binomial on won against lost. Ranges are rounded outward and the net toward zero, so the numbers never claim more than the data.
trial.switch_running: A switch is in progress. Finish it or undo it first.
trial.minimum: Shadow needs at least 20 turns for an answer.
trial.isolation: Replays are close copies of your turns, not exact re-runs.
trial.stopped: Test {id} stopped. Spent ${spend:.2f} of ${cap:.2f}. The {done} finished turns are kept. That's too few for an answer.
trial.stopped_usable: Test {id} stopped with {done} finished turns. Spent ${spend:.2f} of ${cap:.2f}.
trial.controller_exited: The test controller ended before the test finished. Start a new test with /shadow try {model} or hermes shadow try {model}.
controller.tool_denied: This controller can only discover tools and run Shadow test steps.
trial.status: Shadow: test {id}, {done} of {picked} turns, ${spend:.2f} of ${cap:.2f} spent.
trial.progress: Shadow test {id}: {done} of {picked} turns done · ${spend:.2f} of ${cap:.2f} spent
start.title: Try {trying} against your {current}
start.turns: {picked} of your {total} from the last {days} days, picked at random.
start.sent: {providers}: both models and the judge. {keys} keys and {emails} email addresses were removed first.
start.runs_on: Reading files in the folders those chats used, and web lookups (both models get the same pages). Anything that would change something is not run.
start.runs_off: Reading files in the folders those chats used. Web lookups are off, so a turn that needs one stops there. Anything that would change something is not run.
start.cost: About ${estimate:.2f}, capped at ${cap:.2f}. The judge is about ${judge_cost:.2f}.
start.wait: About {minutes} minutes. You can keep working.
start.preview: To see or drop any of the {picked} first, start from chat or Desktop.
start.too_few: Only {picked} of your turns from the last {days} days can be replayed. Shadow needs at least 20. To look further back: {command} try {model} --days 30
start.over_cap: This test would cost about ${estimate:.2f}, over your ${cap:.2f} cap. Even 20 turns, the fewest that can give an answer, would cost about ${minimum:.2f}. To run it, raise the cap: {command} try {model} --budget {higher}
start.plan: your plan: {tokens:,} tokens, worth about ${cost:.2f} at list price
trial.commands: try · results · status · undo · cancel · forget · doctor
trial.more_cost: 30 more turns might settle it, for about ${cost:.2f}.
trial.anyway: To find out on live work instead, switch gradually anyway: {command} switch {id}
